title: nicotiana quadrivalvis var. bigelovii
intro: Nicotiana quadrivalvis var. bigelovii, commonly known as Desert Honeysuckle or Bigelow's Tobacco, is a perennial herb belonging to the nightshade family. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include its ability to relieve respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its calming and sedative effects, making it useful in treating anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of Desert Honeysuckle include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
